name: win-mcp-servers
description: Windows 系统/软件/浏览器/桌面/资源/命令通道 MCP server 套件（6 server + 1 共享底座）

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @win-mcp/core && npm run build --workspace @win-mcp/servers
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @win-mcp/core && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/servers/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run smoke && npm run smoke:bridge && npm run smoke:desktop
